entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, yes, I... I think I need to make a return. I bought this VeloBand Cadence Sensor and it's just... it's really confusing.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, I guess it's a preference? It's just so hard to use. I read the user manual and everything, but the app interface is not what I thought it would be. I really expected more. I just can't seem to get it to do what I want. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can help. Let me just pull up your order details. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Sarah Bell, and the order number is... VF78-22-910.
Thank you, Sarah. One moment... Okay, I see your order. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered 28 days ago. Let me just check the official return policy for you.

Alright, I've just reviewed our policy. It states that all items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. Since you're unfortunately outside that timeframe, I can absolutely process this return for you.
Oh! Really? That's a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with it. Thank you so much, that's great.

You're very welcome. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email we have on file for you now. Just pack the item in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, we'll issue a full refund. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a big help. Thank you again!
My pleasure, Sarah. Have a great day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
